s2_00: Top left of a game splash screen. At the top left is a round black badge with a very dark, barely visible pilot portrait behind two small logo lines: 'Microsoft' in bold white italic letters, M-i-c-r-o-s-o-f-t, and below it a red Z-shaped mark with 'ZIPPER' in bold white italic capitals and 'INTERACTIVE' in thin white italic capitals under it. Below the title is a gold winged badge: two gold feathered wings around a round red medallion with a white skull above two crossed bones. Below that is a sepia-grey photograph of a harbour with a large silver-grey airship in the middle left and small propeller fighter planes. The airship hull is plain smooth grey metal with panel lines; its only lettering is one single line of tiny faint grey letters 'SON OF THE EMPIRE' low on the dark band, partly hidden behind the small planes, exactly where the reference has it. The upper hull has no lettering at all. A thin dark-red stripe runs along the bottom, then a black bar. There is no other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols. Keep the sepia photo soft, with the same grain as the reference.
